newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Consolidated Gold plans rights issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Consolidated Gold plans rights issue.

text.p: Consolidated Gold NL said on Thursday it planned to make a one-for-two rights issue to raise A$18 million.

The rights issue was part of a plan to issue fellow miner Aberfoyle Ltd 38 million shares or 19.5 percent of Consolidated's capital in payment for Aberfoyle's Davyhurst gold mining operations in the Riverina region of south-western New South Wales.
Aberfoyle said in a statement the sale to Consolidated for the shares included certain joint venture interests in the Kookynie region and the Bardoc treatment plant.
Aberfoyle would take a seat on the board of Consolidated after the deal was completed, it said.
"Based on yesterday's closing price of 45 cents per ConsGold share, Aberfoyle's after-tax profit arising from the transaction is expected to be approximately A$7 million."
The deal was likely to be settled in December.
Aberfoyle's share price was up three cents at A$3.00 by 1.50 p.m (0350 GMT).
Consolidated Gold's share price was up two cents at 47 cents.
